title.en: Estate Duty (Visvanathapuram Mariadoss Jagadisa Raju, Deceased) (Remission) Order 1997

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Visvanathapuram Mariadoss Jagadisa Raju, Deceased) (Remission) Order 1997.

2. The estate duty of $39,276.01 payable under the Act on the balance of the Collector’s Award in respect of the property at No. 8 Race Course Road, Singapore, passing on the death of Visvanathapuram Mariadoss Jagadisa Raju on 12th September 1996 is hereby remitted.
